did: I built the phone half of RR14, so what Rust Rounds keeps now goes home for good: each week you send, each error you paste, and what you did on the cards before the weekly shape. Home makes each week's record from what you sent, and a week you didn't send counts as unanswered there. The phone never lets go of its own copy. Opening a ticket is now counted through the same app events every screen uses, by its place in the week, never its name. Before that I placed home's three new tables in the assurance ledger so the server's change could merge, and I merged the route snapshot. Review caught real bugs on the way: the first version forgot which home it was paired with, and treated a phone clock a little ahead of home's as a permanent refusal. Both are fixed, and the sending now reuses the home link's existing parts instead of a copy of them.

calls.title: How a ticket's opens are counted
options: Engagement events by the ticket's place in the week, counted on home
A per-ticket open counter kept on the phone and sent with the week
calls.why: An event may not carry item content, so it names the place (first ticket, second) rather than the ticket, and home counts within the week's dates; that keeps one pipe and no second counter, as the story asked.
calls.undo: Add a counter to the week's record on the phone and a field on home, and drop the week-ticket affordance.

left: Nothing was checked against a real home: the owner is away. Once home runs server#763's image and the new APK is installed, a sent week's record, ticket opens, the card log and My data's counts need a look.
A week sent or a paste kept goes at the lane's next run (the app coming to the front, or a pull), not the moment it is kept, because those stores tell no one of a write.
